notes: Owner decision 2026-11-04: buildings the dated imagery shows demolished are left out of the game. This is an approved, documented exception to the OSM time setting and the building inventory: the frozen OSM snapshot is not edited; tools/build_godot_world.mjs keeps each entry's coverage row with the status demolished and no geometry, and its catalog unit is marked demolished, so it is neither built nor scored.

Add a building only when the dated aerial at full zoom, with the frozen footprint drawn on it, shows no building, and a dated ground photo agrees where one exists. If either is uncertain, leave it standing.

entries.name: Unnamed modular building on 9th Street, 810 Avenue D complex
entries.evidence: Esri World Imagery through Wayback at z19 (about 0.24 m/px), the frozen footprint drawn on it, dates checked in the Esri imagery metadata 2026-11-04: the 2022-11-29 capture (release 25982) still shows all four roofs of the complex on their footprints, which checks the overlay; the 2025-08-29 (release 13192) and 2026-05-26 Vantor (release 63116) captures show pavement and parked cars in the footprint. Google Street View, 9th St: standing in Jan 2023 (pano oclK85J4sfW8LYtDnRpRsg); in Mar 2025 a two-high container stack stands inside the footprint (pano n5Nh0GxrYGwxrIssjkdq4g), and in Sep 2025 only sky shows above the container wall where its roof stood (pano zymx-sHLgpe6167colQIQQ). Checked by verify-810-avenue-d-20261104 (private references).
